content: Gotiꞌa Yu vayaꞌmo apamiꞌniya keꞌaepa gemoꞌmo alagepa aune kavaꞌmo ohaneꞌnifa alagepa kavaꞌmo Gotiꞌa afole aigiye, huno hu maleꞌniya kavaꞌmo alino lave lisiyafeꞌmo yegemo auneꞌagana huno haneꞌniye. Kafugaꞌae kafugaꞌaeꞌmo afumo heꞌa amiꞌnayaꞌmonanafa ani agufa ofalinimoꞌa alagepa huꞌa maige maige huꞌa maisayafeꞌmo Gotitegamo neꞌvaya vayaꞌmo alagi alino alagepa huno oꞌapategaiye.

Alagi alino alagepa huno apateyesinana magoꞌe huꞌa Gotiꞌmo ofalinimo alagi oꞌamiꞌnaesine. Mono huꞌnaya vayaꞌmo aeno kalo paeno apateyesinana apakupi mafaꞌnemoꞌa hosu kavatapimo haneꞌniye, huno osuꞌniyesine.
Huno osuꞌniyesinaꞌmonanafa ani agufa ofalini kavatefeꞌmo muki kafugaꞌae kafugaꞌaeꞌmo hosu kavaꞌapieꞌmo apake okaniꞌa apakesa afifi huꞌa maiꞌnae.
Pulumakamo kolaꞌmoꞌe mememo kolaꞌmoꞌeꞌmo hosu kavaꞌapimo afaꞌa alino oꞌatalegaiye.
Afaꞌa alino oꞌatalegaiyaꞌmofeꞌmo Kalaisiꞌa ma mopafiꞌmo emiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Afumo heꞌa nekamiya kavaꞌe ofalinimo nekamiya kavaꞌefeꞌmo alagi okahauꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo nagufamo alika alo huka nateꞌnane.
Kagaemo afumo heꞌa hiꞌyalamuteꞌmo maleꞌneꞌa nekaya kavaꞌe hosu kavaꞌapilefeꞌmo afumo heꞌa nekamiya kavateꞌefeꞌmo amuse huka oꞌapateꞌnane.
O Gotiyo, mukukafiꞌmo nava gemo huka avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnane. Ani gelefeꞌmo kahauꞌniya kavaꞌmo hisuvafeꞌmo ago emiꞌneꞌnove, huꞌna huꞌnove,

content: huno huꞌniye.

Hogoteno hunoꞌaeꞌmo, Afumo heꞌa nekamiya kavanagi ofalinimo nekamiya kavanagi afumo heꞌa hiꞌyalamuteꞌmo maleꞌneꞌa nekaya kavanagi hosu kavaꞌapilefeꞌmo nekamiya kavanagi huno okahauꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo amuse huka oꞌapateꞌnane, huno ha paiꞌniye. Ani kavaꞌmo nehuꞌapaeꞌmo keꞌaepa gemo akame nehayaꞌmonanafa amuse osuꞌniye.

Inagi henagaꞌamo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, O Gotiyo, kahauꞌniya kavaꞌmo hisuvafeꞌmo emiꞌneꞌnove, huno ha paiꞌniye. Inagi Gotiꞌa henagaꞌamo afole aiꞌniya kavaꞌmo alino afole aino atesiyafeꞌmo hogote kavaꞌmo ago alino ataleꞌniye.

Yesu Kalaisiꞌa Gotiꞌmo hauꞌniya kavaꞌmo huꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo muki afinatefeꞌmo magoke afinaꞌmo agaiꞌa agufaꞌamo amiꞌniya ofaliniletiꞌmo hosu kavatimo alagi aeno kalo paeꞌnigeta laote alagepa vayaꞌamo maiꞌnone.

Muki Yu vayaꞌmogimo mono huꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌmo he tiꞌa maiꞌneꞌapaeꞌmo muki afinaꞌae afinaꞌaeꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌmo neꞌaliꞌapaeꞌmo ani agufa ofalinimo amige amige huꞌa maiꞌnayaꞌmonanafa ani agufa ofalinimoꞌmo hosu kavaꞌapimo afaꞌa alino oꞌatalegaiye.
Nehayaꞌmonanafa ani vekamoꞌa muki afinatefeꞌmo magoke ofalinimo amiteno Goti lamaga haopaleꞌmo fai maiꞌniye.
Ani afinatetiꞌmo Gotiꞌa kame vayaꞌamo alino aiyafiꞌmo apatesiyafeꞌmo agava neꞌmaiye.
Agaemo magoke ofalinimo amiteno apavaleno apaoteꞌmo apateꞌneno alagi alino alagepa huno apateꞌniyanageꞌa alagepa huꞌa maige maige huꞌa maigae.
Agaemo ani kavatetiꞌmo laha paiteno Aote Aunemeꞌamoꞌeꞌmo aeno hakalo huno laha painoꞌaeꞌmo,
Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa,

content.text: Ani agufa kotalake gemo afole aisiya afinaꞌmo apakaetegamo hu malegauve. Keꞌaepa geꞌnimo aliꞌna apaipafiꞌmo maleteꞌna apakesafiꞌmo avo kae malegauve, huno hu maleꞌniye,

content: huno huteno magoꞌe gemo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: hosu kavaꞌapiꞌe keꞌaepa geꞌnimo amagiꞌa ataleꞌnaya kavaꞌapileꞌefeꞌmo magoꞌe huꞌna nagesamo oꞌafiꞌna afaꞌa nagekaniꞌna apategauve,

content: huno huꞌniye.
Gotiꞌa hosu kavaꞌapimo ago alino ataleꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo hosu kavaꞌapilefeꞌmo halate amisaya ofalinimo alagi ohaneꞌniye.
Koli osuta Goti haopaleꞌmo vigetao, huno huꞌniya gemae
Konagaꞌnimogitapae, ani gemo huꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo koli osuta Yesu kolaꞌaletiꞌmo alagi aote mono nopiꞌmo faleta haigetao.
Agaemo lavolavo kitamo ago yakino lateꞌniyanageta agufaletiꞌmo saufa kaꞌmo maige maige huta maisuna kaꞌmo ago valino lateꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmae.
Siosi vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaino neꞌapateya vekamo maiꞌneno Ala kava netimo mono huno nelateya vekamo maiꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo

lama ge laipamo nekalita lole lagesamo oꞌafita lokiya vaita lagesa afita fatago nehutaeꞌmo Goti haopaleꞌmo haigetao. Laipafiꞌmo aino fuli fuli huno lateꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo yuꞌilaga vekatimoꞌmo hosu kavatapimo haneꞌniye, huno nosiye. Lagufaleꞌmo alagepa anitetiꞌmo lagufaleꞌmo faleno lateꞌniyanagi haigetao.
Ani kava huguve, huno laha paiꞌniya vekamoꞌa geꞌamo aeno oꞌatagaegaiyaꞌmofeꞌmo agava neꞌmaita lavayagunagu nehuna kavatefeꞌmo lole lagesamo oꞌafita atafauta alagi higetao.
Lagaemo alita he tita apatesunageꞌapaeꞌmo hapau apayamopafiꞌmo hapauge alagepa kavaꞌmo huge hisayafeꞌmo konagatieꞌmo lagesa afifi huta maigetao.

Mago vayaꞌmo aliꞌa anupa huꞌa neꞌmaiya kavaꞌmo ataleꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo oꞌataleta alagepa kava hiyo, huta hapa paisunageꞌa laha paisageta alita anupa huta maigetao. Alopa afinaꞌmo neꞌegetapa neꞌagayaꞌmofeꞌmo ani kavaꞌmo magoꞌe hutapa hiyo.
Lagaemo lama gemo ago ageta alagepa huta ageꞌnonaꞌmofeꞌmo amagita atalesunafeꞌmo, kanalene, huta hisunana hosu kavatimo aeno kalo paeno atalesiya ofalinimo alagi ohaneꞌniye.
Ohaneꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo Gotiꞌa agoti huno latesiya kavafekeꞌmo koli huta agava maisuna kavaꞌmo haneꞌniye. Aipamo leno neꞌapatesigenoꞌaeꞌmo kame vayaꞌamo atamoꞌmo leno apasaga ligiye.

Muki vayaꞌmogimo Mosese keꞌaepa gemo ago amagiꞌa ataleteꞌapaeꞌmo afa gemo haneꞌniye, huꞌa huꞌnaya vayaꞌmo ago faliꞌnae. Agoti gemo neꞌafiyategamo lole vekalaꞌmoganimofi loleꞌe magoꞌe vayaꞌmogimofi huꞌa apakaefeꞌmo, hosu kavaꞌmo huꞌnae, huꞌa huꞌnageꞌapaeꞌmo hapau huꞌa oꞌapateꞌa kamiti apamagiꞌnae.

Inagi mago vekamoꞌa Goti Mafaꞌneꞌaeꞌmo, ina agufa vekae, huno agiꞌaleꞌmo alino afepi atege kotalake kolaꞌamo alino aote maleꞌniya kolaꞌaeꞌmo ina agufa kolane, huno agesamo afige fiku hapa maeno neꞌapamiya Aunemeꞌaeꞌmo huno faipa huno atege huꞌnisiyana anonaꞌalefeꞌmo magoꞌe huno lusi kayoꞌmo alisiya vekamo maiꞌniye, huꞌa apakesamo afigae.

Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa, hosu kavaꞌapimo anonaꞌapilefeꞌmo aeꞌna atagaina huꞌna kayoꞌmo neꞌapamuva vekamo maiꞌnove, huno huꞌniya vekamo ago ageꞌnone. Magoꞌe gemo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa vayaꞌamo alino fako huno apategaiye, huno hu maleꞌniye.
Gotiꞌa afaꞌa neꞌmaiya vekamo maiꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo ayapiꞌmo apatafauno maiꞌnisiya vayaꞌmogimo lusi kava huꞌa koli hisaya kavaꞌmo haneꞌniye.

Hogotetapa maiꞌnaya kavafeꞌmo lapakesamo afita ho hiyo. Gotiꞌa ha le yaꞌamoꞌmo lapaipafiꞌmo aeno ha leꞌnigetapa ageꞌnae. Agetetapaeꞌmo lusi hanageke yaꞌmo aliꞌnetapaeꞌmo oꞌataleta lokiya vaitapa lapayamufa valeꞌnae.

Lapakaemo vayaꞌmogi vayaꞌai apaulagaleꞌmo huꞌa faipa huꞌa nelapateꞌa lapakaetegamo hosu kavaꞌmo huꞌnaya agufa hanageke yaꞌmo alige mani agufa kana yaꞌmo aliꞌnaya vayaꞌeꞌmo afalu afalugana hutapa neꞌmaiya agufa hanageke yaꞌmo alige hutapa maiꞌnae.

Nagaemo kalavusifiꞌmo maiꞌnogetapaeꞌmo lapau hutapa nateꞌnae. Kagemi yatapimo kumayaꞌmo aliꞌnagetapaeꞌmo kanalene, hutapa huꞌnae. Hogote kagemi yatimo kokuꞌnapiꞌmo okasalisiya kagemi yatimo haneꞌniye, hutapa lapaipafiꞌmo lapakesamo afiꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmae.
Ani kava hutapa maiꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo oꞌataletapa atafauta alagi hutapa maiyo, alopa miyatapimo aligayanagi.
Lapakaemo Gotiꞌa hauꞌniya kavaꞌmo hutetapa lapamiguve, huno huꞌniya yaꞌmo alisayafekeꞌmo atafauta alagi hutapa maiyo.
Ani kavatefeꞌmo Goti mukufi gemoꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Aise afinaꞌmo utesigeno eminesiya vekamo alagi eminegaiye. Gemo afino oꞌmaigifa malage huno eminegaiye.
Inagi fatago vayaꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehaya kavatetiꞌmo alagepa huꞌa maigayaꞌmonanafa mago vekamo halate ataleno aino atagi neno uꞌnisiyana alagi aiseꞌamo amuse huꞌna oꞌategauve,

content: huno hu maleꞌniye.

Huno hu maleꞌniyaꞌmonanafa lagaemo ataleꞌa aiꞌa atagi neꞌa uꞌa lageso nehaya nofi vayapatiꞌmo oꞌmaiꞌnonaꞌmonanafa lagaemo apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehageno apakufamo alino katino neꞌapateya nofi vayapatiꞌmo maiꞌnone.
